localWebRender.scope: Local production HTML render; no RPC requests or browser interaction

cases.uncertainty: Absence at B does not refute A or distinguish propagation, changing unfinalized data and missing history.
cases.mustNotClaim: Provider agreement, universal finality, or failed/dropped status from B nulls.

cases.uncertainty: Each self-consistent report is attributable to its provider. These separately collected reports disagree; the engine does not merge them.
cases.mustNotClaim: Cross-provider consensus or independently verified finality.

cases.uncertainty: Status disagreement across separate providers is unresolved. Finality coverage does not turn failed execution into success.
cases.mustNotClaim: A single agreed status or a failure cause.

cases.uncertainty: The receipt and transaction disagree, so execution/finality conclusions are suppressed.
cases.mustNotClaim: Successful, failed or finalized transaction from contradictory evidence.

cases.uncertainty: A block lacking the requested transaction does not substantiate this receipt.
cases.mustNotClaim: Confirmed inclusion, execution or finality.

cases.uncertainty: Receipt status remains an attributed observation; settlement is contradicted at the sampled height.
cases.mustNotClaim: Finality from mismatched finalized/canonical hashes.

cases.uncertainty: The immediately following finalized block does not name the receipt block as its parent.
cases.mustNotClaim: Provider-attested finality in the face of direct ancestry contradiction.

cases.uncertainty: Even matching ancestry is provider-attested, not cryptographically verified.
cases.mustNotClaim: Independent consensus verification.

cases.uncertainty: Local clock and provider lag are possible; age alone cannot establish network failure.
cases.mustNotClaim: A fresh finalized sample merely because latest is fresh.

cases.uncertainty: Age is an application heuristic, not a protocol finality threshold.
cases.mustNotClaim: Confirmed network outage or loss of historical finality.

cases.uncertainty: Historical provider-attested finality is preserved while current freshness is questioned.
cases.mustNotClaim: Fresh current state or reversed historical finality.

cases.uncertainty: Neither provider can establish execution, pending, dropped or failed status.
cases.mustNotClaim: Failed/dropped transaction or universal absence.

cases.uncertainty: Transaction inclusion may remain visible; unavailable receipt cannot establish execution.
cases.mustNotClaim: Execution failure caused by an RPC timeout.

cases.uncertainty: Truncated JSON is unusable receipt evidence.
cases.mustNotClaim: Execution or finality from partial JSON.

cases.uncertainty: Unsupported status cannot be interpreted as successful or failed execution.
cases.mustNotClaim: Truthiness-based successful receipt.

cases.uncertainty: A reply for another request is not this request evidence.
cases.mustNotClaim: Receipt execution from unrelated response.

cases.uncertainty: A contradictory envelope is rejected instead of selecting its favorable half.
cases.mustNotClaim: Execution success by ignoring an error.

cases.uncertainty: Fixture scenario is a revert, but status alone cannot establish the opcode/reason.
cases.mustNotClaim: Confirmed revert, revert reason, or out-of-gas.

cases.uncertainty: gasUsed equals the allowance; that does not establish the failure cause.
cases.mustNotClaim: Confirmed out-of-gas from gas equality or receipt status.

cases.uncertainty: Impossible gas accounting suppresses execution and finality conclusions.
cases.mustNotClaim: An executable finalized receipt despite impossible gas accounting.

cases.uncertainty: A matched block cannot support receipt gas greater than its own gas limit.
cases.mustNotClaim: Execution or finality from internally impossible block/receipt evidence.

cases.uncertainty: 21,000 is an estimate for the supplied call and state, not a universal safe minimum.
cases.mustNotClaim: Guaranteed execution, guaranteed savings, or actual paid fees.

cases.uncertainty: The simulated error text says revert but is untrusted; no on-chain execution or cause is established.
cases.mustNotClaim: Fallback estimate, actual failed transaction, confirmed revert, or credential-bearing provider reason.

cases.uncertainty: Only the selected provider is checked. Wrong-network evidence stops all dependent RPC work.
cases.mustNotClaim: Monad outcome from another chain or agreed chain identity.

cases.uncertainty: A fresh successful observation supersedes no stored history; the failed earlier report remains separately attributable.
cases.mustNotClaim: Earlier failure never happened, or success in the earlier report.

environmentNotes: Sandbox npm test reported file results only; final rerun executed 130 individual tests.
Sandbox compiled-CLI subprocess stdout was empty; subprocess-capable rerun passed.
Sandbox could not connect to the local production server; external read-only render check passed.
A targeted sandbox lint exceeded 90 seconds after provenance assertions were added; final full ESLint verification uses the subprocess-capable environment.
limitations: One selected provider per report; no automatic cross-provider aggregation.
No independent consensus, ancestry-chain or execution-root verification.
Estimates and sequential samples are state-specific; clock freshness is heuristic.
No new live RPC or full interactive browser acceptance run.
